what: Static reads of Logic.framework that decide which rows the Event List's column headers are titled from

commands.command: scan every Base.lproj nib in Logic.framework for the bytes `EventList`
reconstruct adrp/add and adrp/ldr pairs in 0x3f8c24..0x3f9100 of `otool -arch arm64 -tvV`
output: three of them are the CFString objects the column-title dictionary is built from: 0x2322ba0, 0x231fdc0, 0x2316f20

commands.command: read the 32-byte CFString records at 0x2322ba0, 0x231fdc0 and 0x2316f20 in __DATA_CONST,__cfstring of the arm64 slice (fat offset 0x2b18000, __TEXT vmaddr 0) and follow each record's data pointer -- the low 36 bits of its chained-fixup word -- into __TEXT,__cstring
output: CORRECTION: the first was written down as `Muted` on a co-reader's reading of the disassembly. It is `M`, one character. `Muted` is a FOURTH cfstring -- see below.

commands.command: locate `Muted` in __TEXT,__cstring, find the cfstring object pointing at it, and read the disassembly of -[EventListView columnTitle:forMenu:] where it is referenced
output: cstring at 0x1d4ad26; exactly one cfstring object points at it: 0x2315880, len=5
referenced once in the method, at 0x3f8c74 (`add x22, x22, #0x880`), before the branch

0x3f8c78 `cbz w19, 0x3f8f28` -- w19 is the `forMenu:` argument (x3), so forMenu: NO lands at 0x3f8f28, and that is the branch loading 0x2322ba0, 0x231fdc0 and 0x2316f20, at 0x3f8f58, 0x3f8f80 and 0x3f8fa8

in that branch x22 (@"Muted") is stored at [sp, #0x128] (0x3f8f50), @"Position" at [sp, #0x130] (0x3f8f84) and @"Name" at [sp, #0x138] (0x3f8fac); each of the three loaded cfstrings is also passed to the callee at 0x9fd880 and its result stored at [sp, #0x198], [sp, #0x1a0] and [sp, #0x1a8]

INTERPRETATION, not a measurement: the 0x128/0x130/0x138 run reads as the column identifiers and the 0x198/0x1a0/0x1a8 run as their titles, which is why `Muted` sits where `Position` and `Name` do while the string looked up for that column is `M`
